game_deviations: Source render surfaces are given real 28mm closed plank thickness, with extra stations for smooth curvature.
Keel top is geometrically 0.38m, following the source stated intent; the source primitive beam thickness would otherwise place its upper face above that value.
Seat height is fitted to delivered outer planking at source x=0.4m, with the same 20mm hip inset. Reference source seat is recorded separately.
Algae is a conformal material coating on the original t=0.74..0.98 band, avoiding a floating or penetrating overlay.
Oar is turned along the side and cloth moved 0.25m outward to avoid source decorative overlaps; source dimensions, floating character and shared root are retained.
No cabin, standing route, mast or rudder is invented for this flooded inverted prop.

export.animations: authored static pose; transforms/pivot markers retained
export.lods: static distance meshes with 1024/512 max texture dimension
export.collision_mode: separate static concave meshes; moving parts require engine setup
